title: BillingPlanUsagePrice
description: The specific usage pricing for this plan for a specific metric.

id.description: Unique identifier of the charge created by Lago.

invoice_display_name.description: Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the plan will be used as the default display name.

billable_metric_codes.description: The billable metrics codes that this plan is associate with.

description.description: A friendly description for this plan.

package_pricing.description: The interval used for recurring billing. It represents the frequency at which subscription billing occurs. The interval can be one of the following values: yearly, quarterly, monthly or weekly.

volume_pricing.description: The pricing to use based on tiered volumes
